name: implexa
description: Skill recording for any AI session — capture once, replay forever. Demonstrate any workflow once and Implexa turns it into a 6-component reusable skill (intent + inputs + procedure + decision points + output contract + outcome signal) via post-demonstration interview. Share with your team via a domain-gated link, post publicly (PII removed), or fork from a horizontal Playbook library. Every captured workflow includes Revenoid tool calls, non-tool actions logged via record_demo_note, and full host-side conversation transcript. ~26 MCP tools across the Skill Graph stack plus external data fetching (Fiber AI company + people search, Coresignal career history + jobs + LinkedIn posts, Apollo contacts). Renders wherever the LLM lives. Built on MCIP.
